# 4 Ezra Chapter 13 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

## 13:3 — figure from the sea

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "as-the-form-of-a-man, and-I-saw that-this-man-flew-with-the-clouds" | Literal — quasi similitudo hominis |
| LOGOS | "the form of a man, and I saw this man flying with the clouds" | Same without hyphens |
| PNEUMA | "the shape of a man — and he was flying on the clouds" | Cleaner |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** "The form of a man, and I saw this man flying with the clouds of heaven" (LOGOS). The "quasi" (as it were) before "form" is important — this is not simply a man but a man-like figure.

---

## 13:10 — the weapons of his mouth

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "stream-of-fire...flaming-breath...sparks-and-tempests" | Literal threefold description |
| LOGOS | "stream of fire...flaming breath...sparks and tempests" | Same |
| PNEUMA | "river of fire...blazing breath...sparks and storm winds" | "River" and "storm winds" are slight variations |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** "Stream of fire...flaming breath...sparks and tempests" (LOGOS). "Stream" is the more accurate translation of flumen; "tempests" preserves the Latin's tempestates.

---

## 13:26 — "the Most High is keeping" — present vs. present perfect

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "whom-the-Most-High-is-keeping-many-ages" | Literal, present continuous |
| LOGOS | "whom the Most High is keeping through many ages" | Same |
| PNEUMA | "the one the Most High has been keeping through the ages" | Present perfect — emphasizes duration |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** "Whom the Most High is keeping through many ages" (LOGOS). The Latin present active is exactly rendered; PNEUMA's perfect tense is acceptable but shifts the emphasis.

---

## 13:40 — the ten tribes

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "the-ten-tribes-which-were-carried-away...in-the-days-of-Hoshea" | Literal |
| LOGOS | "the ten tribes which were carried away...in the days of Hoshea the king" | Full proper noun preserved |
| PNEUMA | "the ten tribes who were taken from their homeland in the days of King Hoshea" | "King Hoshea" vs. "Hoshea the king" |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** "The ten tribes which were carried away from their own land in the days of Hoshea the king" (LOGOS). "Hoshea the king" preserves the biblical naming convention.

---

## 13:55 — wisdom as mother

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "you-have-called-understanding-your-mother" | Literal |
| LOGOS | "you have called understanding your mother" | Same |
| PNEUMA | "you made understanding your mother" | "Made" is slightly more active |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** "You have called understanding your mother" (LOGOS). The Latin vocasti (you have called) is exactly preserved; PNEUMA's "made" alters the phrasing.

---

## Total disagreements: 5
